title_suffix: model-native subagents and fail-closed goal execution
summary: OSpec 1.8.2 replaces the 1.8.1 Orca and agent-CLI fallback chain with target-bound model-native subagents. Codex/GPT use spawn_agent and wait_agent, Claude uses Task, Gemini uses @generalist, OpenCode uses @mention, and registered Cursor or Copilot sessions use their native agent contexts. Missing, expired, future-dated, or mismatched capability now blocks before process launch or run-artifact creation. Loop executor evidence is bound to the exact native session that issued each action.
new: Added a machine-readable nativeSubagent contract to runtime adapter resolutions and launch artifacts for every supported model harness.
Bound Loop actions, heartbeats, review claims, and results to the target and reportedAt identity of the native capability session that issued the work.
improved: Runtime adapter resolution is deterministic and native-only, with one target-specific candidate and no Orca, PATH, CLI, cache, or current-controller probing.
Goal and Loop guidance now tells the controlling model to dispatch one fresh native subagent per safe packet, wait for the batch, record real child IDs, and continue ticking.
Launch plans no longer contain agent CLI command vectors, and shell or generic targets remain blocked until a registered native primitive is selected.
fixed: Fixed auto adapter selection preferring Orca over the active model harness and silently falling back to target CLIs or the current controller.
Fixed capability snapshots being reused across target changes, accepting future timestamps, or authorizing old actions after a session rotation.
Fixed document review reuse accepting stale target, interactivity, capability, or native-session provenance.
Fixed orphaned document-review claims, controller locks, and task-graph locks becoming permanently stuck after worker loss, PID reuse, or future-dated filesystem timestamps.
Fixed Loop heartbeat and result paths accepting injected non-native adapters or executor evidence that was not claimed by the current native child.
Fixed Loop resume immediately retriggering the no-progress circuit breaker, failed executors being counted twice, and small prompt limits dropping packet and lifecycle commands.
Fixed verification evidence accepting PASSED without an explicit zero exit code, and hardened L3 command policies against appended arguments, absolute paths, and parent traversal.
Fixed normalized task artifact ID collisions that could cause separate task IDs to overwrite the same evidence directory.
Fixed partial Goal creation and post-move archive failures leaving active state, session briefs, Markdown links, or project indexes inconsistent; both workflows now roll back transactionally.
Fixed loop watch, execute orchestrate, launch --run --command, and review --run --command retaining process-launch behavior; they now fail before side effects.
Fixed CLI help, localized templates, and project conventions continuing to recommend removed fallback paths.
docs: Updated the managed ospec-goal skill, AI guides, execution protocol, Loop engineering contract, usage guides, README, and four localized project conventions for native-only execution.
Documented the exact Codex, Claude, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor, and Copilot native dispatch lifecycle and the hard gate used when a capability is unavailable.
